entries.title: Turbo Overkill
entries.definitive_edition: Turbo Overkill on Windows PC, with Ultimate Edition extras if desired

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with current updates.

primary.version: Current PC release / Ultimate Edition extras as desired
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original full-release platform with native PC settings/capture flexibility, current Enhanced/Ultimate Edition update support, and optional digital extras; console releases do not have exclusive playable content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Turbo Overkill on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current build. Choose the Ultimate Edition bundle or add the free Original Syn prequel comic/digital extras if you want the broadest non-gameplay package.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC full release with PC settings and current Ultimate/Enhanced update path.
